make.name: Rivian
make.description: American electric vehicle maker founded in 2009 by RJ Scaringe and listed since 2021. It builds the R1T pickup, R1S SUV, R2 SUV and Commercial Van in Normal, Illinois, and has a technology joint venture with Volkswagen Group.

models.name: R1T
models.description: Rivian's first production vehicle, a five-seat electric pickup with a gear tunnel, built in Normal, Illinois since September 2021. It was re-engineered as the Gen 2 R1T for the 2025 model year.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Original R1T built in Normal, Illinois from September 2021 with Bosch-supplied quad motors at launch; dual-motor versions and Standard, Standard+, Large and Max packs were added for the 2023-2024 model years.

generations.name: Gen 2
generations.description: Heavily re-engineered R1T revealed in June 2024 for the 2025 model year: in-house Enduro motors (new Tri and 1,025 hp Quad), zonal electronics, new cameras and computers, and an LFP Standard pack, with near-identical styling. For the 2027 model year Rivian renamed the trims Premium (dual), Premium Long Range, Performance (tri) and Quad, and the Standard pack was dropped in 2026.

variants.name: Performance Dual Large (Premium with Power upgrade)
Performance Dual Max (Premium Long Range with Power upgrade)

models.name: R1S
models.description: Three-row, seven-seat electric SUV sharing its platform with the R1T, with first deliveries in December 2021. It was re-engineered as the Gen 2 R1S for the 2025 model year.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Original R1S built in Normal, Illinois from December 2021 with Bosch-supplied quad motors at launch; dual-motor versions and Standard, Standard+, Large and Max packs were added for the 2023-2024 model years.

generations.name: Gen 2
generations.description: Heavily re-engineered R1S revealed in June 2024 for the 2025 model year: in-house Enduro motors (new Tri and 1,025 hp Quad), zonal electronics, new cameras and computers, and an LFP Standard pack, with near-identical styling. For the 2027 model year Rivian renamed the trims Premium (dual), Premium Long Range, Performance (tri) and Quad, and the Standard pack was dropped in 2026.

variants.name: Performance Dual Large (Premium with Power upgrade)
Performance Dual Max (Premium Long Range with Power upgrade)

models.name: R2
models.description: Five-seat midsize electric SUV unveiled on 7 March 2024 and built in Normal, Illinois from April 2026. Public deliveries began on 9 June 2026 with the Performance Launch Package; Premium and Standard versions follow through 2027.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: First R2, sold as a 2027 model year in the US (EPA) with an 87.9 kWh pack and a NACS charge port.

models.name: R3
models.description: Compact electric crossover on the R2 platform, shown in March 2024 together with the off-road-styled R3X. No price or specifications have been announced; production is tied to Rivian's Georgia plant, expected to be completed in 2028, and the R3X is due before the R3.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Announced only. Start year is provisional: Rivian says production comes after the Georgia plant opens (expected 2028), 'probably before the end of the decade'.

models.name: Commercial Van
models.description: Electric delivery van developed for Amazon, which has run them since July 2022; Rivian opened orders to any business fleet in February 2025. Sold in 500 and 700 sizes; a larger 129 kWh pack and a dual-motor AWD version of the 700 began deliveries in October 2026.

generations.name: First generation
generations.description: Front-wheel-drive van with a 100 kWh LFP pack in fleet-sale form (2025); the 700 gained a 129 kWh pack and an AWD option for 2027.

legacy_notes.note: R1T 'Explore (2021)' is a Gen 1 Quad-Motor Large pack truck. Its 410 mi range belongs to the 2024 Dual-Motor Max pack, its 830 lb-ft torque is not the Quad's 908 lb-ft, and its $73,000 price matches no Quad price.
R1S 'Launch Edition (2022)' is the Gen 1 Quad-Motor Large pack. Its 400 mi range belongs to the 2024 Dual-Motor Max pack.

R1T 'Explore' Gen 2 mixes trims: $71,700 is the 2025 Dual Standard price including destination, 420 mi is Dual Max, 2.5 s is the Quad. Claimed on Gen 2 Dual Max (its range figure). There was no Gen 2 'Explore' trim.
R1S 'Launch Edition' Gen 2 mixes trims: 410 mi is Dual Max, $76,990 matches no sourced Dual Max price, 2.6 s matches no Gen 2 trim. Claimed on Gen 2 Dual Max.
R2 row held pre-launch guesses ($45,000, 300 mi, 3.0 s). Claimed on the Performance AWD, the only R2 on sale (from 9 June 2026, $57,990, 330 mi EPA, 3.6 s).
Fleet 'Delivery 700' is the Commercial Van 700 (100 kWh). The 0-60 of 7.0 s and 110 mph top speed have no source; range is 160 mi (Rivian, not an official EPA rating).
Fleet 'Delivery 500' is the Commercial Van 500 (100 kWh); range 161 mi (Rivian, not an official EPA rating).
R3X has no announced price, range or acceleration; the legacy $55,000 / 300 mi / 3.0 s values were placeholders. Not on sale; production expected after the Georgia plant opens (2028).
R3 has no announced price or specs; the legacy $45,000 / 300 mi / 3.0 s values were placeholders. Rivian only says it will start below the R2.
